name: Internet Essentials
description: Hand-picked core protocols every RFC reader should have offline: keyword norms, IPv4/IPv6, TCP/UDP, DNS(+SEC), DHCP, email, HTTP/1.1+2+3, TLS 1.3, QUIC, and the RFC process documents. All current (non-obsolete) IDs; set "history": true in a copy to pull in the obsoleted lineage.
